items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Yeah. He played piano for me in the big band most of the time.

ctx.x: Yeah. He played piano for me in the big band most of the time. Because Emile, he didn't want to go out of town. He was an uptown piano player, one of them fine piano players, you know. Played that soothing, good music. He was a good piano player. Read everything. He played in theatre for years and years, him and another fellow.
And let me see, who was on drums. I don't know what...
